description: This file defines several Orleans grains and related classes for stream consumption, including Passive_ConsumerGrain, Jerk_ConsumerGrain, and ImplicitSubscribeGrain, along with observer classes and interfaces. It handles stream subscription, unsubscription, and message processing in a test context.

classes.name: Passive_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that subscribes to streams, maintains counters and handles start/stop of consumption.

classes.name: Jerk_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain designed to unsubscribe from streams immediately upon subscription.

classes.name: CounterObserver
classes.description: An observer implementing IAsyncObserver to count and log received items.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscribeGrain
classes.description: A specialization of Passive_ConsumerGrain with implicit stream subscriptions.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes state when the grain activates.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the grain deactivates.

methods.name: GetCountOfOnAddFuncCalled
methods.description: Returns how many times OnSubscribed was called.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Calculates total items consumed across observers.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all streams and clears observers.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles incoming stream subscription requests, creating observers and managing subscriptions.
